description: This file defines the interface for a TimerFactory class in the beerocks namespace, which provides a virtual method to create timer instances. It includes necessary headers, uses include guards, and is designed for dependency injection and mocking in unit tests.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: An abstract base class defining a factory interface for creating timer objects within the beerocks namespace. It promotes dependency injection and ease of mocking in testing environments.

methods.name: create_instance
methods.description: Pure virtual method that must be overridden to generate a new Timer object wrapped in a unique_ptr.
